_source: Static UI keys for the mobile store count-and-receive screen (route st-receive, pototype/mobile-field.jsx MStReceive L36-92). KEYS ONLY — never a translation. ZERO-MINT: all seven values are keys that ALREADY EXIST in docs/extract/i18n-full.json today, so this slice touches the sacred file not at all and spends none of the i18n round that BLOCKERS.md B-266 has to size first. Nine prototype strings have NO key in any layer and are therefore NOT rendered by this screen and NOT invented here — they are reported for a Wei mint round once B-266 is ruled (minting copy that can never render wastes a sacred round permanently, which is exactly what B-266 warns about). The nine: 'ตรวจนับ + รับของ' (L60 title), 'รับจริง' (L70), 'ขาด' (L76), 'เกิน' (L76), 'ยืนยันรับของครบ' + 'ยืนยันรับของ (รับขาด)' (L86), 'รับของสำเร็จ' (L52), 'รับขาดบางรายการ' (L53), 'กลับรายการรอรับ' (L54), plus 'รูปของ' (L78) if the photo tile ever returns.
_layers: MIXED — read each field with the noted resolver. tp() = phrases layer (the Thai phrase IS the key); t() = dict layer (a stable id).
_deviations: THREE copy under-claims, each an existing key that says LESS than the prototype rather than an invented string that says more. (1) title=tp 'ตรวจนับ-รับของ' vs the prototype's 'ตรวจนับ + รับของ' — same words, hyphen instead of ' + '; this exact phrase is already the st-grlist CTA that OPENS this screen (applied under B-296), so the pair reads consistently. (2) colReceived=t gr.create.colReceived 'รับ' vs 'รับจริง' — the same column of the same document in the merged web GR create form. (3) confirm=t common.confirm 'ยืนยัน' — the exact shared prefix of BOTH prototype CTA labels; the ครบ-vs-ขาด distinction those labels carry is preserved by the prototype's OWN second encoding of it, the button tone (L86 ok-green when complete, warn-amber when short), which is derived from real ordered-vs-counted quantities. NOT reused, deliberately: 'ขาด' has two byte-exact dict matches (labor.att.optAbsent 'absent', inv.status.out 'out of stock') that mean a DIFFERENT word once en/zh/ar are filled — reusing either would render correct Thai today and a wrong translation later, so the short/over delta is shown as a signed number + the prototype's own colour instead, and the two words go to the mint list.
title: ตรวจนับ-รับของ
